context: A boss reviews HR and operational news
purpose: Teach: 抽選/移籍/攻略/収納/主観/賛同/真摯/表彰

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の表彰候補、もう絞り込んだか?
lines.en: Have you narrowed down the award candidates for this quarter?
lines.style: Measured opening. Direct but not harsh. Slight pause after the question, inviting the answer without pressure. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の移籍組も含めて、真摯に評価しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've evaluated everyone carefully, including the new transfers in sales.
lines.style: Steady, methodical delivery. Confidence in the work done, not defensiveness. Even pace. Slight emphasis on 'carefully' — showing the thoroughness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 抽選で決めるんじゃないんだから、主観に流されるな。
lines.en: This isn't a lottery, so don't let personal bias creep in.
lines.style: Firmer edge now. Not accusatory, but a clear principle being stated. Weight on 'isn't' and 'don't.' The tone of someone who's seen this go wrong before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: もちろんです。攻略チームの貢献も賛同を得ています。
lines.en: Of course. The strike team's contributions have buy-in from the team as well.
lines.style: Reassuring without being obsequious. Quick, smooth delivery showing he's thought this through. Slight lift at the end — offering additional evidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料は収納フォルダに揃えておけ。
lines.en: Make sure all the materials are organized in the shared folder.
lines.style: Practical, concise. Final instruction delivered without emphasis — matter-of-fact. The tone of someone moving through the checklist.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Crisp, immediate. Single beat of acknowledgment. Clean close — no extra words, just confirmation.
